query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_vendas,
  SUM(finalAmount) as faturamento_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN saleType = 'BALCAO' THEN finalAmount ELSE 0 END) as balcao,
  SUM(CASE WHEN saleType = 'A_PRAZO' THEN finalAmount ELSE 0 END) as a_prazo,
  SUM(CASE WHEN saleType = 'DELIVERY' THEN finalAmount ELSE 0 END) as delivery,
  MIN(createdAt) as primeira_venda,
  MAX(createdAt) as ultima_venda
FROM sales
WHERE MONTH(createdAt) = MONTH(NOW())
  AND YEAR(createdAt) = YEAR(NOW())
